signals.usability_note: Large trees in the foreground block most of the house. Only a sliver of light siding and a roofline are visible in the distance, and part of the left side is blurred. The frontage cannot be assessed reliably.
signals.notes: A dark SUV or car sits in the driveway at left, and a row of small evergreen shrubs runs along the house; the lawn is patchy and shaded, and a red fire hydrant stands at the curb.
